description:
• About our brand and products:
MWE 360 is a premier manufacturer and global provider of innovative photo booth solutions, specializing in high-quality 360 photo booths, iPad photo booths, and professional lighting accessories. We empower entrepreneurs and event professionals to start or scale their event rental businesses with cutting-edge technology. Our products, including the popular 360 spin booths and the ChackTok software integration, are designed for durability, ease of use, and maximum visual impact at weddings, parties, and corporate events.
• What makes us different:

  • Direct-from-Factory Quality: We offer high-performance hardware that meets professional standards at competitive price points.

  • Software Ecosystem: Our seamless integration with the ChackTok App provides a turnkey solution for customers, not just hardware.

  • Fast Global Shipping: We ensure reliable delivery to the US and Europe, which is critical for customers with upcoming event deadlines.

  • Comprehensive Support: We provide extensive tutorials and 24/7 customer service, ensuring low return rates and high customer satisfaction.


• How affiliates can earn:

High Ticket Commission: Earn  5%commission on every sale. With an average order value (AOV) of $800-$2000, you can earn $40 to $160+ per single referral.


Generous Cookie Duration:  30 days. Our products have a longer decision cycle, and we ensure you get credited for the lead.


Performance Bonuses: Extra rewards and higher commission tiers for top-performing affiliates who achieve monthly sales milestones.


High Conversion Rate: Our niche target audience and professional branding lead to strong conversion rates among event industry professionals.


• How to promote us:

Video Reviews & Tutorials: Show the 360 booth in action on YouTube or TikTok. Unboxing and "How to start a business" videos perform best.


Blog Content: Write reviews, "Top Photo Booths for 2024," or "Best Wedding Business Ideas" articles.


Social Media: Share stunning 360-degree videos on Instagram and Pinterest to capture the attention of event planners.


Coupon Sharing: Provide your audience with an exclusive discount code to incentivize immediate purchases.


• Other information:

We provide our affiliates with a full media kit, including high-resolution images, video demos, and promotional banners. We are open to custom collaborations, such as providing sample units for large-scale influencers (100k+ followers) or co-hosting webinars. Join us today and help your audience build a profitable event business with MWE 360!
